description: 极简大留白、产品界面与逻辑拆解，适合产品发布、软件方案和清晰型汇报

identity.composition: 16:9 白色画布；宽阔留白、强烈左对齐和一处产品界面或证据焦点。
identity.hierarchy: 一句结论先行，留出理解空间，再用界面、模块或原则解释产品价值。
identity.image_treatment: 界面截图保留真实边界，置于清晰的设备或画布框中，不使用装饰性背景图。
identity.module_language: 细线、轻边框、少量硬色、设备框和逻辑清单。
identity.chart_evidence: 图表保持单一关系和大字号标注，避免在留白版面里塞入高密度仪表盘。
identity.motion: 使用克制的渐进显示与焦点转移，保持页面空间感和稳定阅读顺序。

canvas.grid: strong left alignment with generous open region
canvas.density: low, one statement plus 1-3 product modules

components.chart: Use a single trend, comparison or value with generous whitespace and direct labels.
components.table: Prefer structured rows or tiles; never shrink text to make a dense table fit.
components.evidence_card: Treat product UI, workflow and user result as distinct evidence blocks.
components.image: Use real interface imagery in a simple frame; preserve its text and information hierarchy.
